title: Friday Quick Tip
subtitle: Half a team at practice
hook: Only six of twelve players showed up. What now?
intro: You planned for a full team.
statement: A small practice can be a chance for more touches.
q1: Do you run your plan with smaller groups —
q2: or switch to games and extra touches?
q3: What can you do with six that you cannot with twelve?
t1: Both can work. But small practices pay off
t2: when the kids who came get more reps.
cta: Coaches — what do you do with half a team?
ctaLines: Small games. Extra touches. Same plan, smaller groups.
ctaPrompt: Share your practice habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
Only six of twelve players showed up. What now?
You planned for a full team. Half the players are out.
A small practice can be a chance for more touches.
Keep the plan or switch it up. Every team is different.
What do you do with half a team? Share your habit in the comments.
